items.summary: Unauthenticated privilege escalation in the WordPress plugin "Automation Web Platform – Notifications and OTP for WooCommerce" (≤4.8.6): its public REST signup route copies attacker-controlled fields into user meta with no allowlist, and the OTP step is bypassable — letting remote attackers register an admin account.

Improper input validation in on-prem Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator lets an unauthenticated remote attacker reach privileged internal functionality and compromise the orchestrator host plus managed Edge devices in certificate-based deployments. Actively exploited; added to CISA KEV on Sep 22.

Remote code execution in Next.js 16.2.0–16.3.5 next/og ImageResponse on the Node.js runtime: unescaped values reach SVG output via the Satori library and crafted og-image requests can trigger server-side code execution. Fixed in Next.js 16.3.6.

Code-injection flaw in on-prem Microsoft SharePoint Server 2016/2019 and Subscription Edition: a low-privilege authenticated attacker can execute arbitrary code, and default anonymous WebPart configurations make it effectively pre-auth RCE. Added to CISA KEV on Sep 25 with active exploitation confirmed.

MikroTik RouterOS SSH flaw (part of CERT.pl's "MikroTrick" chain): an unauthenticated attacker can open an SSH session channel and send exec requests, bypassing authentication entirely — enabling full admin takeover of internet-facing devices. Added to CISA KEV on Sep 25; fixed in RouterOS 6.49.21 / 7.23.4 / 7.24.2.
